title: System Explorer what-changed diff
description: What changed on one host between a stored snapshot and now (SPEC section 10): added and removed object ids plus changed objects with the dotted paths that differ, per collection, computed by diff-on-read. Changed paths use the evidence-path language, so a change entry cites facts the way an opinion does. Empty diff sections are omitted: a collection with no changes does not appear. Shared $defs are duplicated from observation.schema.json deliberately so each schema file is standalone.

since_requested.description: The request's since parameter resolved to UTC (relative offsets like -24h resolve at request time). Absent when the request omitted since — the baseline is then the oldest stored snapshot by design, not by fallback.

fallback.description: Present when nothing stored was as old as since_requested and the oldest snapshot stands in — the diff covers less span than asked for.

rebooted.description: baseline.boot_id differs from current_boot_id: at least one boot boundary lies inside the diff span.

status.description: partial when at least one baselined collection failed to collect live (its diff is missing; errors says which). error when no diff was computed at all: history disabled, store empty, or since unparseable.

subsystems.description: Subsystem name -> collection name -> diff. Only subsystems and collections with changes appear; no changes anywhere is an empty object.

allOf.description: An error envelope must say what failed; a partial one must say what is missing.
A computed diff carries its baseline and boot identity.

bootId.description: /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id with dashes stripped (the system adapter's rendering); the literal 'unknown' when unreadable.

paths.description: Dotted paths within the item summary that differ (facts.ActiveState, worst_opinion_level) — the same path language opinions cite evidence with.
